body_markdown:
Enerflex has been awarded a major Engineered Systems project to provide more than 1 GW of low-emission, behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation for a large-scale North American data center development. Combined with additional recent awards, Enerflex’s behind-the-meter power generation backlog now exceeds 1.75 GW, highlighting the Company’s growing role in supporting the power requirements of data centers and digital infrastructure.


[Read Full Press Release](https://investors.enerflex.com/node/7936/pdf)
